title: Ukraine Targets 'Russia's Google' In Third Strike On Yandex Data Centers
content: Ukraine has struck three of Russian tech giant Yandex’s data centers in four days. Known as "Russia's Google," Yandex said it shut down a facility in the country's Vladimir region following an attack on October 11. The strikes have reportedly caused huge disruptions to digital services in Russia.

title: Impoverished Afghans Sell Kidneys On The Black Market 'Out Of Sheer Desperation'

title: Deep Debt, Failing Health: Afghans Desperate To Escape Poverty Sell Kidneys To Survive
content: As millions of Afghans struggle just to afford food, some have turned to selling one of their last remaining resources: a healthy kidney. The costs can be devastating: One woman said her health has deteriorated since she sold a kidney for a modest sum that failed to clear her family's debts.
